description: This file provides helper functions and a data structure for parsing and constructing network host and port configurations, including parsing host:port strings and generating HTTP URL strings with fallback options.

methods.name: parseHostPort(from:)
methods.description: Parses a string to extract host and port information, supporting IPv6 bracketed notation.

methods.name: httpURLString(host:port:fallback:)
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP URL string from optional host and port, adding brackets if needed for IPv6 addresses, or returns a fallback URL.
